review.observations: Object A (Left): A grey-green steel wardrobe viewed from the front-left. The door is hinged on the viewer's right and is open. It features a horizontal hanging rail near the top, a recessed latch, and three louvres on the door. The base has a recessed dark kick plate. The top surface is flat. Object B (Right): A grey-green steel wardrobe viewed from a front-right angle. The door is hinged on the viewer's left and is open. It features a horizontal hanging rail, a recessed latch, and three louvres. The base has a recessed dark kick plate. The top surface is beveled. Comparison: The objects share the same color, material, and general features (rail, louvres, latch, kick plate). However, the handedness is inverted: A has the hinge on the viewer's right, while B has the hinge on the viewer's left. The top surface of B is beveled, whereas A is flat. The viewing angle of B is more oblique, showing the right side panel, while A is more frontal.
defects: Hinge handedness is inverted between A and B (A: viewer's right, B: viewer's left).
Top surface of B is beveled, while A is flat.
Viewing angle of B is more oblique, showing the right side panel, while A is more frontal.
fixes: Re-render B with the hinge on the viewer's right to match A.
Adjust the top surface of B to be flat to match A.
Adjust the viewing angle of B to be more frontal to match A.

acceptance_rule: Export checks pass and visual fit is at least 7/10; reviewer ready flag is retained separately.
